579-3755-3995.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
579-3755-3995.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2511-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

803-3951-5703-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
803-3951-5703-8095.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2281-4247-4681.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

849-1263-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

206-240-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

1369-7086-7308.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Mona Lisa.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Mona Lisa's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Mona Lisa's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Mona Lisa's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-6791.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

4013-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {2}{C} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
4013-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

586-3967-5258-5618-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
586-3967-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

524-1167-5957.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

3371-4019-5149-5385.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Codie has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Power Artifact attached to any artifact.
Any additional nonpermanent card in hand with mana to cast it.
3371-4019-5149-5385.description:
Cast Aura Finesse by paying {U}, attaching Power Artifact to Codie and drawing a card.
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining trigger.
3371-4019-5149-5385.notes: Step 1 is necessary because you cannot cast Power Artifact once Codie is on the battlefield.

719-997-1238-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1987-3075-3227-4714.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-3227-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.

364-1987-2493-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

957-2556-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Mnemonic Wall.
957-2556-4305.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep on your next extra turn, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
